title: Employees
subtitle: The employee directory: people, their employment details and where they sit in the organization.
teamSubtitle: Employees in the departments you manage.
readOnlyNote: You have view-only access to employee records.
demoDataNote: Simulated data — changes are kept only until the page is reloaded.
noPermission: Your role cannot create or edit employee records.

directory.label: Employee directory
directory.search: Search by name, employee number or email

profile.notFound: This employee does not exist or was removed.
profile.restricted: Personal information (date of birth, gender, nationality, marital status, personal contact details, address and emergency contact) is available only to HR roles.
profile.forbidden: This employee is not in your team.
profile.photoPlaceholder: No photo — photo upload is not available yet.

form.employeeNumberHint: Letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. EMP-0250. Must be unique.
form.contractEndHint: Required for contract, temporary and internship employees.
form.probationHint: Optional. Within one year of the hire date.
form.managerHint: Active employees of the selected department or a parent department.
form.managerSearch: Search by name or employee number
form.saveError: The employee could not be saved.
form.fixErrors: Some fields need attention. Please review the highlighted fields.

validation.phone: Enter a valid phone number (digits, spaces, + and -).
validation.tooYoung: The employee must be at least 16 years old on the hire date.
validation.hireDateTooFar: The hire date cannot be more than a year from today.
validation.contractBeforeHire: The contract cannot start before the hire date.
validation.contractEndBeforeStart: The contract must end after it starts.
validation.probationRange: Probation must end after the hire date and within one year.
validation.employeeNumberFormat: Use 3–20 letters, digits or hyphens (for example EMP-0250).
validation.latinRequired: Enter the name in English (Latin letters).
validation.fileType: Allowed file types: PDF, JPG, PNG and DOCX.
validation.fileSize: The file must be 10 MB or smaller.

serverErrors.not-found: The selected record no longer exists.
serverErrors.position-department: This position does not belong to the selected department.
serverErrors.self: An employee cannot be their own manager.
serverErrors.circular: This person reports to the employee, so they cannot be their manager.
serverErrors.manager-department: The manager must work in the employee's department or a parent department.
serverErrors.department-manager: This employee manages a department. Assign another department manager first.
serverErrors.has-direct-reports: Other employees report to this person. Assign them another manager first.
serverErrors.inactive-assignment: The employee's department, position or location is inactive. Update the assignment first.

confirm.deactivateText: The employee will be marked inactive. Their records are kept and they can be activated again later.

documents.title: Documents
documents.simulated: Simulated document storage: files are not uploaded or stored anywhere — only their details are recorded in this demo.
documents.name: Document name
documents.fileHint: PDF, JPG, PNG or DOCX, up to 10 MB. The file is not sent or stored — only its name and size are recorded.
